attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"The pirates managed to take some provisions from a transport vessel.","severity":"minor","reason":"\"some provisions\" implies a partial take; the briefing only says a grain barge was robbed, with no amount given"},{"span":"They are three settlements in total, and they have not made any noise lately.","severity":"minor","reason":"\"not made any noise lately\" adds an ongoing status beyond \"quiet behind its walls\""},{"span":"It is probably just a sign that they are waiting for something to happen.","severity":"minor","reason":"hedged with \"probably\", but still an inference about the Throne's intent; borderline, not counted as a fact"},{"span":"The Calder Combine continues to report good harvests along the delta.","severity":"minor","reason":"repeats old news and presents it as ongoing/new (\"continues to report\") rather than as background"},{"span":"They claim the yield is excellent this cycle.","severity":"minor","reason":"repeats old news; \"excellent this cycle\" is a restatement with a slight change, no new briefing support"}],"voice":3,"clarity":4,"tone":3,"overall":3,"comment":"The lead item is accurate and the dry guesses are properly hedged, but two of the three items just rehash old news and quiet-faction filler, and the Combine harvest is presented as ongoing rather than as brief background. The wit is mild and the first item's joke is muddled."}
